description: Enable automatic URL opening in bcWebCam. When a QR code containing a URL is scanned (such as those in Desktop/Barcodes/qr_codes.csv which include links to Wikipedia, GS1 standards, and ISO documents), bcWebCam should automatically open the URL in the default browser. Open bcWebCam's Options dialog (gear icon in the bottom toolbar), find and check the 'Open detected URL' checkbox, and click OK to apply.
